text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Experience is power. That's how I know
Wonder
Acute will always perform well,
no matter the
circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
There goes Wonder Acute! Now that's
what I call
a final spurt!

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
You said it! I thought she looked tired,
but
Granny Acute's still got it!

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, wheeze... Thank you, everyone. Looks like I made it across the finish line.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
But to be honest, I wasn't sure it would
happen.
And I'm not sure where to go
from here...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
This is the best that I can do, so this may
just be
the end of the road for me. But...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: My word, racing has been fun.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Watching her from the stands, seeing
that smile
on her face, it hits me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I think I know what Wonder Acute's
been thinking
about.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This race settled something for her. She's satisfied. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But the fans haven't come to the same
conclusion.
Their cheers are so loud,
they echo through the
racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Later that night...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: There's nothing to be sad about, dearie.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
After all... nothing lasts forever. You
understand
that, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I've already accomplished everything I
set out to
do.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
After so much time spent dreaming of
catching up
to Falco, I finally did it.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And not only that, but even if it was for
just a
moment, I was shining with a
golden light just as
bright as hers.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I was able to inspire people looking to
stand back
up and get a fresh start on
life.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's almost hard to believe that I was
actually able
to do something so
wonderful.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
There's no such thing as an Umamusume
who can
run forever.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
In fact, there are those among us
doomed to
retire without ever having
achieved their
dreams...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Do you know when the best time to quit
is?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It's when you've achieved your goal. You
go out
on top and leave them cheering.
Don't you
agree?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
You know, Trainer. It's thanks to you
that I was
able to make my dreams come
true.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
And waaay faster than I ever imagined
possible.
We did it back at the Kawasaki
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The Kawasaki Kinen, where we both
pushed
ourselves to the very brink of
reason in order to
catch up to Smart
Falcon and put on a memorable
race.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's as if we accomplished her dreams too soon. If we hadn't entered that race, then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We would still have so much ahead of
us. Wonder
Acute's path would stretch
on and on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Acute. Do you have a second?
There's
someone I want you to meet.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
She's a friend of mine. She's a little older
than
you, actually.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Acuuuute! Hey, hey, hey! You know this
girl?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Can't say why, but she and I really hit it
off. It's
almost like fate! ...Wait. Don't
tell me she's one of
your classmates?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I thought we'd continue meeting more
and more
new people... It honestly did
feel like the racing
life might go on
forever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And I wanted to spend every moment of
that time
with Wonder Acute.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Oh dear, please don't make that face.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
I... I'm really happy. I'm so happy that I
was able
to have so much fun racing with
you, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: And... I'm so happy I met you. Honestly.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: Er, well...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't want to race anymore,
there's
nothing to be done. It's not like I
can force her,
and I wouldn't want to.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But... if that's not the reason...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Well, something like that. I mean... it's
not that I
don't like running, but...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
It used to be like... like my feelings
toward racing
gushed up out of the
depths of my heart, nice and
warm like a
hot spring...

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
As long as those feelings are gone... my
body
can't keep up. No matter what I
do.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
So it's not that she doesn't like racing
anymore,
but that the flame of
motivation that fueled her is
sputtering
out.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if it would really make her
happy if I
agree it's best to quit now.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's still too soon. In fact, it's way too
soon. She
runs on dirt.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Running on dirt doesn't put as much
strain on
runners' legs, meaning dirt
runners can continue
their careers for
quite some time. And not only
that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Older runners typically help to usher in
the next
generation as part of a
long-running cycle.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Leaving now would completely remove
her from
that cycle. And while that's not
necessarily a bad
thing...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
More importantly, if Wonder Acute
leaves
running like this, won't she regret
it?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
So what do you say, Trainer? I think it's
about
time I hang it up.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you saying you want me to
keep racing?
choice_data_list: もう少しだけ考えてくれないか
もう少しだけ考えてくれない？

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text: But... why?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If quitting will really make her happy,
that's one
thing.
choice_data_list: 後悔だけはしてほしくないから

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
But I don't want her to spend the rest of
her life in
regret, thinking about what
could have been if
she didn't.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear... You're worrying quite a lot
over little
old me.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
If you feel that strongly about it, then... I
suppose
I can probably try running
another race or two.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Yes... sure. I may not have a goal in front
of me,
but I think I can handle one more
race.
choice_data_list: 受け入れてくれるのか？

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Just because I don't want to see you
looking sad.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It looks like I managed to get my
feelings through
to her, if only just.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I can do now is maintain that
connection and
wait until some new light
of inspiration appears.

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Trainer. Did you have a race
in mind?

text_block_list.name: Wonder Acute
text_block_list.text:
...Next month? That's quite soon. Oh,
but I'm sure
it'll be fine. Okay, let's do
that, then.
choice_data_list: 来月の『帝王賞』にしよう。いい？

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
All I can do now is squeeze in as many
races as I
can in the hopes that she
doesn't have time to let
her feelings
flag. Even so...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Who knows how long I can keep it up
after the
Teio Sho.
